mapper.select: SELECT t.other_user_id AS id, u.username AS receiverName, -- 对方用户名（会话标题） s.username AS senderName, -- 最后一条消息的实际发送者 p.sender AS senderId, -- 建议加上：最后一条消息发送者的ID（前端判断用） p.content AS content, p.is_read AS isRead, p.create_time AS createTime FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN sender = #{userId} THEN receiver ELSE sender END AS other_user_id, MAX(id) AS last_id FROM private WHERE sender = #{userId} OR receiver = #{userId} GROUP BY other_user_id HAVING other_user_id <> #{userId} ) t JOIN private p ON p.id = t.last_id LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = t.other_user_id -- 对方 LEFT JOIN user s ON s.id = p.sender -- ★ 最后一条消息的发送者 ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
